Ruling: representation; project retained. The deduction before the QBI deduction now adds Form 1040 line 13b, the zero parameter behind the Schedule 1-A refusal (BUG-0007), to the Schedule A choice; the second transcription, told that Schedule 1-A is refused, omitted the term. Equal in value in this slice; the term is kept so the line 13b refusal propagates and the expression reads as the corrected instruction ("Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11a, minus lines 12e and 13b", i8995-correction). Ruling: model error; the reply takes the input qbi.dividends on every return, where the project reads it only when ordinary dividends are above zero (zero otherwise), because the interview asks the section 199A dividend amount only after dividends are entered (f1099div p. 5, Box 5, "Shows the portion of the amount in box 1a that may be eligible for the 20% qualified business income deduction under section 199A": box 5 is part of box 1a, so without ordinary dividends there is none). On a return with no dividends the reply therefore needs an answer the interview does not ask. Triage executable-triage-v2 (`.transcription/triage/2025/qbi.json`, pass f8a472cd57e9; 1,767 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026): 2,207 of 2,355 in-scope comparisons agree; differences by kind {"candidate-unknown": 134, "project-unknown": 14}; on completed returns 97 candidate-unknown (the recorded witnesses name qbi.dividends, with the project's value zero); the project-unknown are partial records that withhold an answer the project needs. No value differs where both give one. The project line is retained.

Ruling: model error; f8995 p. 1, line 12, "Enter your net capital gain, if any, increased by any qualified dividends", and i8995 p. 4, Line 12, "line 3a, plus your net capital gain": the candidate omits the qualified dividends (Form 1040 line 3a), which the project adds through f1040.line3a_if_ordinary. Ruled by reading: the scoped reply names interfaces the candidate bank does not resolve, as in the earlier line-scoped passes of this lane.
